# Shakil Ahmed Samim | Conversion Tracking Setup

> Freelance conversion tracking specialist. Fixes broken GA4, Google Tag
> Manager, Meta Conversions API, and Google Ads conversion tracking for
> marketers, agencies, and ecommerce brands, so ad spend is measured
> accurately before scaling.

## Services

- Tracking audit: find duplicate events, missing values, weak dedupe,
  cookie loss, and broken conversion paths in an existing setup.
- Server-side Google Tag Manager: first-party event routing for GA4,
  Google Ads, and Meta CAPI with clean event match quality.
- Meta Conversions API: CAPI, catalog feed, CRM events, lead quality,
  and offline conversion imports.
- Measurement handoff: a readable event map, launch checklist, debug
  evidence, and next-step operating notes delivered after setup.

## Who this is for

Marketers, agencies, and ecommerce store owners who are running paid
ads (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) and are not confident their
conversion data is accurate, either because of iOS/browser signal
loss, a misconfigured GTM container, or missing server-side tracking.

## Proof

500+ tracking setups completed, average 5.0 rating across Upwork,
Fiverr, and LinkedIn client reviews. Reviews and case studies are on
the site's Reviews section.
